mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) and atazanavir both carry nephrotoxicity risk, with potential additive renal dysfunction and reduced atazanavir absorption due to tobramycin's effects on GI flora and pH-dependent absorption.
action: Monitor renal function closely; consider alternative aminoglycoside or antibacterial agent; ensure adequate hydration and maintain dosing intervals based on creatinine clearance.
